answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the ferrous queue naming the haven that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 7 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, each alias burns 7 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the harbor record publishes exactly who is still on probation. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
